data.long_meaning: Adiit is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'adi', meaning 'first' or 'beginning'. This name is given to a child who is believed to be the primal force, the beginning of a new generation or a new era. The name Adiit carries the meaning “First, beginning, primal” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adiit usually hope their child will grow to embody first, beginning, primal and live with faith, good character and purpose.
